correctness.rationale: The incidence residues {0,1,3} construct the Fano plane. Nonincident point-line flags force all remaining six vertices in one propagation wave. All noncollinear point triples succeed by projective-linear transitivity and the explicit two-wave canonical triple; duality covers lines. Every subset without these witnesses lies inside one closed neighborhood, and every closed neighborhood fails after the initial observation step. Stars intersect in at most two vertices, giving failure coefficients 1,14,63,56,14. Nonincidence pairs give the 28 optima; the line graph of the 4-regular bipartite nonincidence graph has 28 vertices, degree six, 84 edges, diameter three. All 16384 subsets were independently checked by two supplied source programs with exact equality against the proposed criterion.

value.rationale: The exact failure complex of the unique cubic girth-six cage is a natural geometric object, not an arbitrary statistic: all unsuccessful placements are classified by the fourteen closed stars and counted at every size, with precise reliability for every independent sensor rate. The 28 optimal placements have a fully resolved, connected, bounded-diameter exchange geometry, which quantifies robustness of sparse monitoring rather than merely its minimum size.
